toc.title: Antidotus contra scandalum, datum ab his, qui ab Ecclesiis Evangelicis ad Papatum deficiunt: una cum demonstratione errorum Papatus, & admonitione graui ad Apostatas, vt resipiscant & ad Dominum redeuertantur

book: A single Latin treatise printed at Bern in 1608 against apostasy from the Evangelical churches to Rome, built as a title page, an address to the reader, and one continuous text with no numbered divisions on the sheet, closing with a finis and errata.
